- Repository: <https://github.com/Dennis40816/nvt_combiner>
- Submodule: `third-party/nvt_combiner`
- Commit: `6490edf3a357f6047a1e3f3aa1c1d70a767e68eb`

This unmodified source dependency implements decision 187's repository intake.
The submodule retains the upstream `LICENSE`; this adjacent record remains
available without initializing the submodule.

To retrieve the pinned source for inspection, run from the repository root:

```text
git submodule update --init -- third-party/nvt_combiner
```

CI leaves submodules uninitialized. This source is not connected to a processor
or included in NFC release packages, and the current Combiner remains in use.
R07-02 owns the later behavior comparison; this intake makes no byte-parity or
support claim. The [roadmap intake](../docs/architecture/nfc_roadmap.md#121-python-combiner-intake--2026-09-21)
owns the remaining plan.
